plainTranslation: Composite Ascendant in Sagittarius: feels open, adventurous, and fun-loving. At its best, this gives the relationship an easygoing, expansive vibe. The pressure point is seeming flaky or commitment-shy.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from approved project composite chart material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
